The menu's counts and the header keep refreshing after a click on them.

To update, run the new `dpiswitch.exe` from anywhere and accept the offer to install over the installed version (one administrator prompt). Settings, lists, configs and verdicts are kept.

## Interface

- **The menu's verdict counts no longer freeze.** A part of the page was not refreshed while the focus was in it, so as not to replace a field being typed into. Since the pages became one document, a menu item or a button keeps the focus once clicked: the counts beside "Verdicts" stayed as they were at that click -- "0 · 0" after a reset while the verdicts page under them was full again -- and the header would stop the same way after a mode button. Only a field being edited holds a part now.
